title: CBP nationwide encounters: border apprehensions and inadmissibles by month, region, demographic and citizenship
agency: U.S. Department of Homeland Security, Customs and Border Protection
questions: border apprehensions this year vs last year
unaccompanied children encountered at the border
encounters by state or Border Patrol sector

manual.how: Open https://www.cbp.gov/document/stats/nationwide-encounters, download the newest 'Nationwide Encounters' CSV (by AOR or by state), and upload it with ingest.

cache.why: Files are replaced monthly, with revisions to earlier months.

redistribution.why: CBP statistics are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Customs and Border Protection, Nationwide Encounters ({dataset}), cbp.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which encounters? Southwest Land Border, Northern Land Border, or nationwide (including Other: airports and seaports); Border Patrol apprehensions between ports or OFO inadmissibles at ports, or both. Default: Southwest Land Border, both components, said as such.
Which months? Federal fiscal years (October-September); the current year is partial (FYTD). Default: the latest month and the same month a year earlier.
